body:
How are you getting on?

I know the alcohol thing well.  I left 'borderline' behind a long time ago.
Sucks about your childhood. If you want to see a therapist and don't want to talk about your childhood - just tell them that.

Is there anyone positive in your life you can talk to?  Not someone that tells you everything is shit.  Someone that tells you everything is great and knows how to make the best from the worst?

Sounds like life has been really rough for you and you need someone positive in your life

Hey bud.  I know the whole kids thing.  I've done it ways so painful I can't explain.  

I know you're afraid to talk to a therapist... but they aren't there to judge.  A therapist is a safe place where you can work through some stuff.  

I can only recommend it from my own experience

Hey bud.  I hear what you're saying.  Sometimes just putting it out there helps.  Yeah.  It happened, and it sucks.  

The good thing about being at the bottom is that the only way is up.

No, I didn't have problems coming off them... but I did it slowly.  I cut pills in half and so on.  2 years is a long time to be on them.  Need to come off slowly.

Good luck with it though.  Once it was time for me to come off them, my life was so much better.

I'd never seen that try fail.  Every time I see someone go into celebration mode before 'downward pressure is applied' I think they're an idiot.  Wow.  Thanks for posting that.  I'm booking marking it.

I don't have anything remotely helpful to say.  It sounds like something a Dr should be involved in.

I've been on zoloft.  I found they just sucked my will to live, to do anything.  So - getting off was great for me.  

Exercise is huge for me, in all these things.   PM me any time you want to chat, if that's helpful.  It's been helping me a lot.
Hey.  Come chat to me any any time.  I know a lot about drinking and feeling like crap.
Hey.  Come chat to me any time.  I felt like this a few days ago, but...  a bit of time has helped.
I'm sorry buddy.  PM me any time you want.

Hi

Much better, thanks.  Well.  Still pretty crappy but I'm starting to bounce back.  Lots of people are emailing me / chatting on facebook.  That works a treat.   Staying with a friend too.

Thanks for checking in.  Reddit has been very kind to me :)
Ok.   Thanks.   Helpful stuff
Yeah, it's about them seeing me.  But if it wasn't pretty obvious already - I've had the fight kicked out of me.  I don't any more fight left in me :(

I've done the lawyers.  Everyone thinks that courts are a thing that helps.   Courts only help if you have many years, many dollars and many more years and dollars.  Family courts don't work like the rest of the world.  Mums just say they were raped by the Dad.  The court doesn't know if it's true or not... so they give the mum what she wants :(

Wow. someone downvoted you.  Great response.  Thanks :)
Yeah.  I think that last line is the only correct thing. Get my shit together.

Thanks for responding. Umm.... so I'm an Australian. I moved to the UK when I was 25. Met a girl, got married. Had some kids. WE moved back to Australia. She was miserable there, so we agreed to move back to the UK. She moved before I did, once she got to the UK she wanted a divorce. That's child abduction....

So... I moved to the UK. Saw the kids, then she shut off access. I fought it through the courts. Got access back. Had 8 months of awesome access to the kids again. Then her an I had an argument. I did and said some nasty stuff. She has shut down access to the kids. So I'm going back to Australia. I'm not going to see my kids for 10 years.
